data.body: Port applied on branch autofix-chunk12-20260603. COMMIT 1 SHA: 154853d9d0. Fix: corrected snapshot key lookup from jira_issue.get('comments', []) to jira_issue.get('comment', {}).get('comments', []) matching the Jira REST API structure. Reference: origin/audit/c2-leaf-gap-agent commit 23705b8f51. Main's _normalize_comment_body (ADF->text + RECONCILER_MARKER strip + whitespace strip) was already correct — only the snapshot key needed fixing. Added 6 tests in test_outbound_differ_comment_dedup.py including the exact bug 4572 marker-echo dedup scenario. Pre-existing test files using wrong snapshot shape updated. Pending live probe validation before ticket close.
